description: Follow a YouTube channel for the account (needs an API key): its new videos land in the account’s inbox (check_inbox) and notify the browsers that turned that on. Optionally only videos whose title has one of `words`, no Shorts, or only for the next `days`. Following one already followed changes only the parts of its rule given. Playlists can’t be followed: YouTube lists only their first 15 videos, so new ones at the end never show. What it holds now is not news, except a video from the last 3 days. Up to 20 follows (100 on Pro); feeds are read every 15 minutes.

days.description: Stop following after this many days. Omit to follow until unfollowed.

words.description: Only videos whose title has one of these are news (case and accents ignored). Omit for every video.

name: follow_channel
title: Follow a channel
